info.description:
راهنمای یکپارچه‌سازی APIهای جیبیت برای توسعه‌دهندگان. این مستندات سرویس‌های کوبانک (حساب‌ها)، درگاه پرداخت، احراز هویت بایومتریک، پیامک، استعلام، قرارداد و امضای دیجیتال، و دایرکت دبیت را پوشش می‌دهد.

پایهٔ همهٔ درخواست‌ها `https://napi.jibit.ir` است. برای معرفی محصولات و دریافت دسترسی به [جیبیت](https://jibit.ir) مراجعه کنید.

get.description:
A single endpoint that routes to one of 4 distinct card services, selected by the boolean
query parameters that are present. At most one of `deposit`, `iban` and `nationalCode` may be
set to `true`; setting more than one returns `parameters.not_acceptable`.

Each variant is billed, rate-limited and error-reported independently, so each one is
documented as its own service below. The `#` suffix in those entries is a documentation
alias only - every variant is requested against this same URL, `/v1/cards`.
The `parameters` and `x-errors` of this operation are the union over all variants; use the
per-variant service entry for the required parameters and the exact error codes of the
variant you are calling.

| # | Service | Required query parameters |
|---|---------|---------------------------|
| 1 | [Get card information](#cardInfo) | `number` |
| 2 | [Convert card to deposit](#deposit) | `number`, `deposit=true` |
| 3 | [Convert card to IBAN](#iban) | `number`, `iban=true` |
| 4 | [Convert card to national code](#nationalCode) | `number`, `nationalCode=true` |

Variant 1 is the default: when none of the three flags is `true`, the card information
service is selected.

get.description:
A single endpoint that routes to one of 13 distinct matching services, selected by the
combination of query parameters that are present. Exactly one combination must be supplied;
otherwise `query_parameters.not_provided` is returned.

Each variant is billed, rate-limited and error-reported independently, so each one is
documented as its own service below. The `#` suffix in those entries is a documentation
alias only - every variant is requested against this same URL, `/v1/services/matching`.
The `parameters` and `x-errors` of this operation are the union over all variants; use the
per-variant service entry for the required parameters and the exact error codes of the
variant you are calling.

| # | Service | Required query parameters |
|---|---------|---------------------------|
| 1 | [Match IBAN with national code](#iban-nationalCode) | `iban`, `nationalCode` |
| 2 | [Match IBAN with identity](#iban-nationalCode-birthDate) | `iban`, `nationalCode`, `birthDate` |
| 3 | [Match IBAN with legal identity](#iban-legalNationalCode) | `iban`, `legalNationalCode` |
| 4 | [Match IBAN with name](#iban-name) | `iban`, `name` |
| 5 | [Match card number with name](#cardNumber-name) | `cardNumber`, `name` |
| 6 | [Match deposit number with name](#bank-depositNumber-name) | `bank`, `depositNumber`, `name` |
| 7 | [Match card number with identity](#cardNumber-nationalCode-birthDate) | `cardNumber`, `nationalCode`, `birthDate` |
| 8 | [Match card number with national code](#cardNumber-nationalCode) | `cardNumber`, `nationalCode` |
| 9 | [Match deposit number with identity](#bank-depositNumber-nationalCode-birthDate) | `bank`, `depositNumber`, `nationalCode`, `birthDate` |
| 10 | [Match deposit number with national code](#bank-depositNumber-nationalCode) | `bank`, `depositNumber`, `nationalCode` |
| 11 | [Match national code with mobile number](#nationalCode-mobileNumber) | `nationalCode`, `mobileNumber` |
| 12 | [Match legal national code with mobile number](#legalNationalCode-mobileNumber) | `legalNationalCode`, `mobileNumber` |
| 13 | [Match FIDA with passport number](#fida-passportNumber) | `fida`, `passportNumber` |

Variants 2 and 7 are resolved before variants 1 and 8 respectively, so supplying `birthDate`
alongside a national code always selects the identity variant.

post.description:
Verifies a purchase by the client. The client should call this API after we redirect the user to the client's callback URL.

Only purchases with the state `READY_TO_VERIFY` can be verified.

If the client does not call this API, the PSP will automatically reverse the payment after a certain period of time, and the purchase state will be set to `EXPIRED`.

Note 1: This API does not have a request body and can be called using both `GET` and `POST` methods.

Note 2: For using Auto-verify feature consult our admins. Note that using this feature does not guaranty that purchase will be verified 100%, but it can decrease the number of `EXPIRED` purchases due to not verified by client significantly. So a client still must call the verification API with this feature enabled, but in most cases the API will return `payment.already_verified` error.

**Possible Error Codes:**

* `ip.not_trusted`: When the client IP is not trusted. * `client.not_active`: When the client is inactive. * `purchase.not_found`: When the purchase does not found. * `payment.already_verified`: When the purchase is already verified. * `purchase.invalid_state`: When the purchase's state is invalid. * `purchase.already_reversed`: When the purchase is already reversed. * `security.auth_required`: The bearer JWT token is not in the request header as the `Authorization` parameter. * `token.verification_failed`: When the access token is invalid or expired. * `server.error`: Internal server error. Please provide the value of the fingerprint to help us track the exact problem internally.

**Authorization**: Bearer JWT token in the header.

Encapsulates the purchase verification result.
 It indicates whether the purchase verification was successful, failed, already verified, unknown.

status.description:
It is the status of verification.
 **Possible values:**
 - `SUCCESSFUL`: The verification was successful.
 - `FAILED`: The verification failed. The payment amount will be returned to the user's bank account. See  step 10.
 - `UNKNOWN`: The verification was unknown (typically due to a network failure). The client can retry verification before expiration or inquire about the purchase later to determine the final state.
 - `ALREADY_VERIFIED`: The purchase is already verified, such as a purchase with a `SUCCESS` state.
 - `NOT_VERIFIABLE`: The purchase is not ready for verification and cannot be verified. Only purchases in the `READY_TO_VERIFY` state can be verified.
